excluded.csharp_check_build: Runs dotnet build against a .csproj, which needs the .NET SDK wherever the snapshots are recorded; the fixture has no C# project.
excluded.didi_control_room: A dashboard of this server's own state: its log tail, uptime and request history, which differ on every run.
excluded.nav_query_path: The fixture has no navigation region, and a path query needs a baked navigation mesh on a map the NavigationServer has synchronised.
excluded.project_get_uid_map: Maps every uid in the project, the addon's included, and a fresh copy mints new uids for the addon's SVGs when it imports them.
excluded.project_verify_changes: Runs the game on a scratch copy of the project with the proposed changes applied, which is a launch rather than a read of the fixture.
excluded.runtime_get_tree: Attached to an editor it walks the editor's own interface, several hundred engine-internal nodes; it is a game-session read, and the recording starts no game.
excluded.runtime_read_logs: Returns the server and extension log stream since the editor started, so how many records it holds depends on how far startup got before the call.
excluded.runtime_read_output: Returns the editor's own console output since it started, so how many records it holds depends on how far startup got before the call.
excluded.runtime_read_profiler: Returns measured frame times and monitor samples, which differ on every run.
excluded.runtime_recovery_status: Answers only in managed recovery mode, which needs --managed-editor and a recovery workspace.
excluded.spatial_query_frustum: A frustum has no 2D form, and the fixture is a 2D scene.
excluded.viewport_capture_passes: Renders pixels; a headless editor refuses it the same way it refuses viewport_capture_frame, whose refusal is recorded.
excluded.viewport_diff_capture: Needs a baseline capture, and a headless editor refuses to capture one the same way it refuses viewport_capture_frame, whose refusal is recorded.
